title: Work project scope: preserve explicit selection across dock remounts
outcome: Round-1 Codex Low, WorkPanel.tsx:12: after choosing project B with session A focused, switching to Files and back remounts Work and initialProject chooses A ahead of the saved B. Preserve explicit selection above the remount boundary while keeping the agreed focused-project default for initial selection. Evaluate dock-origin default only as a separate context decision, not an automatic change to the user's independent selection.
acceptance: Dock remount regression retains explicitly selected B with A focused; initial/default and removed-project fallback remain intentional.
